badgeHint: Show the unread badge on the bell.
channelsHint: Where notifications appear by default. The in-app center always records them.
description: Control how the notification center delivers and retains alerts.
dndHint: Mute toast/desktop/push during these hours (the center still records; critical alerts always come through).
focusAwareHint: Don't fire a desktop notification for a conversation you're already viewing.
osPermissionDenied: Denied. Enable notifications for Cognia in your OS settings.
osPermissionHint: Allow Cognia to show native desktop notifications.
perSourceHint: Turn a source off to mute its toast/desktop/push — it still appears in the center history.
snoozeAutoWakeHint: Re-surface a snoozed notification when new activity arrives in the same thread.
soundHint: Play a sound for new notifications.
title: Notifications
